narr: An upper and surface low near the SC coast directed moisture into the region, and combined with diurnal heating, to provide locally heavy rain with some reports of flooding in Orangeburg, SC.
ev: Orangeburg Co EM reported flood waters entered 4 apartments at the Malibu Apartments on Malibu Dr. Time estimated.

The Times and Democrat newspaper in Orangeburg relayed a report and photo, via social media, of a flooded vehicle on Frederick St near Chestnut St in the University Village area of SC State Univ. in Orangeburg. Time estimated.
